results.description:
I manage aggressive, high-risk takeovers in New York City and am one of the best at it. Buying failed companies is business, not personal, nor for the fainthearted. I don't have the time nor inclination to deal with all the emotional fluff.

So when I decide to keep Gemma Ford on temporarily after buying her company, and she looks at me like I'm the monster of Manhattan, I know I should get rid of her.

Do I? No.

Because there's something about the passionate, outspoken and curvy brunette that makes me want to do very bad things to her. Outside the boardroom.

And I just might.

GEMMA

I knew this was a bad idea - staying on to watch Drew Carrington tear apart my company. Facing the shame is hard enough, but when we meet in real life and his nostrils flare, I don't know if it's from disgust or lust?

That's the question.

One I can never find out the answer to.

Charming Mr Carrington is book four of The Obsidian Club series – a standalone set of billionaire romances.  If you love spicy workplace romance, touch her and die tropes with bantering wealthy men, and scorching love scenes then you'll love Drew and Gemma's spicy love story.
